body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Shure showcased 'SE420', its Dual TruAcoustic MicroSpeakers at CES 2010, which uses a dedicated tweeter and woofer to provide a detailed sound stage. Low, mids, and highs are distinct and defined-for accurate reproduction of all the details of your music.
Its frequency range is 20Hz-19kHz. Suggested price (MSRP) is $400.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
